fig01_training_curves.png.caption: Figure 1: Training convergence dynamics across four deep reinforcement learning architectures over 500 interaction steps under Master Seed 42, showing episodic return (A) and loss reduction trajectories (B).

fig02_model_win_rate_comparison.png.caption: Figure 2: Empirical win-rate comparison across DRL architectures evaluated against Random, Expert, and Self-Play opponents (N=250 games per condition) with 95% Wilson score confidence intervals.

fig03_random_opponent_comparison.png.caption: Figure 3: Tactical performance comparison against Uniform Random opponent across DQN and PPO, demonstrating win rates with 95% Wilson CIs (A), captures per game (B), and tokens successfully brought home (C).

fig04_expert_opponent_comparison.png.caption: Figure 4: Strategic evaluation against Heuristic Expert opponent (Alhajry 2012 priority), showing win rates across architectures (A) and final token completion differential between DQN and Expert (B).

fig05_reward_comparison.png.caption: Figure 5: Episodic reward distributions across evaluation matchups (N=250 games per matchup), displaying medians, means, interquartile ranges, and outlier densities.

fig06_game_length_comparison.png.caption: Figure 6: Game duration (turns) distributions across tournament conditions, comparing empirical density curves (A) and boxplot quartiles with outlier caps (B).

fig07_confidence_intervals.png.caption: Figure 7: Forest plot comparing 95% Wilson Score Confidence Intervals with 10,000-resample non-parametric Bootstrap intervals across tournament matchups, confirming strict asymptotic agreement.

fig08_seed_variability.png.caption: Figure 8: Evaluation performance stability across independent PRNG seed blocks (N=50 games per block) and variance bounds, illustrating cross-seed invariance under stationary policies.

fig09_ablation_results.png.caption: Figure 9: Comprehensive ablation study results across action masking (A), state representation (B), and reward shaping (C), highlighting catastrophic policy collapse without action masking and honest non-significance in pilot representation testing.

fig10_robustness_results.png.caption: Figure 10: Robustness stress-testing across environmental transition stochasticity under loaded dice (A) and opponent generalization transfer gap from naive random to heuristic expert (B).
